name: Origin Food Group LLC
old_description: It’s a given that “good food” should taste good. But good food should also be more nutritious.
about:
Origin Food Group traces its roots to South America, where a family-owned company spent nearly four decades pioneering functional foods—introducing Swiss-style drinkable and spoonable yogurts, fortifying every product with vitamins and minerals, and using premium ingredients such as HOWARU® probiotics and TruCal® calcium. The business expanded to North America in 2009, establishing its U.S. headquarters and production facility in Statesville, North Carolina.

At the Statesville plant, the company develops and manufactures a range of better-for-you dairy products, including yogurts enriched with probiotics, antioxidant-rich superfruits, cholesterol-lowering Benecol®, and iron for anemia prevention. Operations cover contract packing, private labeling, and full-scale dairy processing, with milk sourced locally from Stamey Farms, a multi-generational dairy partner in Iredell County. All formulation and production are handled in-house.

Origin serves food and beverage brands seeking private-label dairy and functional-food solutions, as well as companies needing contract packing for nutritional products. Its customer base includes marketers of on-the-go health foods, retailers building store-brand yogurt lines, and nutrition-focused brands requiring specific functional benefits such as digestive health, bone support, or cholesterol management.

The company’s founding premise—that no one should compromise nutrition for taste or convenience—continues to drive its approach. By combining dairy expertise with targeted fortification, Origin aims to deliver measurable wellness benefits in every product, a philosophy that began with its early innovations in South America and now extends to its U.S. manufacturing.

name: Original Maine Factory Store
old_description: From lifelong Mainers to those who visit every chance they get, these gifts capture what draws us all here
about:
Original Maine Factory Store operates from Portland, Maine, where it was founded in 2017. The venture began as a mission to revive the state's 1901 flag, a design featuring a pine tree and North Star that flew over Maine from 1901 to 1909. The founders, inspired by that historic symbol, built a brand around Maine craftsmanship and design.

The company designs and produces a range of Maine-themed goods, including flags, apparel such as t-shirts, hoodies, and hats, and home goods. According to the company, all products are designed in Portland and most are manufactured there, with many items made by local makers and artisans. The operation includes a factory store in Portland and an online shop powered by Shopify. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Original Maine serves retail customers, tourists, and gift buyers looking for authentically Maine products. Its customer base includes lifelong Mainers and visitors who want a piece of the state's independent spirit. The product line spans flags, vintage-style graphic tees, beanies, dad hats, trucker hats, and collaborative items such as the Flowfold x Original Maine collection.

The company distinguishes itself through its commitment to local design and production, tying each item to Maine's heritage. Its affiliation with Maine Flag Company underscores a focus on quality flag manufacturing alongside the broader gift collection. The brand positions itself as a celebration of Maine craftsmanship rather than a generic souvenir maker.

name: Orman's Furniture
old_description: Use our design center to find the right colors for your home. Choose from multiple stain options and wood species.
about:
Orman's Furniture operates from a showroom on Metcalf Avenue in Overland Park, Kansas, where it has served the Kansas City metro area for over five decades. The business bears the Orman name, and longtime customers reference Tim Orman as a hands-on presence who takes personal interest in custom projects, such as converting an heirloom English oak table into a coffee table. The company positions itself as a local alternative to national big-box retailers.

The store stocks bedroom, dining room, living room, and office furniture, with a focus on solid-wood pieces sourced from Amish workshops such as J&R Woodworking and Indian Trail, alongside other American-made lines. Customers can custom-order many items, selecting from nine wood species — including brown maple, cherry, elm, hard maple, hickory, quarter-sawn white oak, red oak, walnut, and wormy maple — plus a range of stains, paints, genuine and faux leathers, Ultraleather, and multiple fabric lines such as Revolution Performance Fabrics and Easy Living Performance Fabrics. A design center on the website lets buyers visualize color and material combinations before purchase.

The clientele is primarily residential, from homeowners furnishing a first house to those seeking heirloom-quality pieces. Reviews highlight the store's willingness to tackle one-off modifications, quick delivery, and a large warehouse layout that allows browsing extensive inventory in person.

Orman's Furniture frames its differentiation around value and trust, explicitly contrasting itself with out-of-state chains that "promise more than they can deliver." The emphasis on Amish craftsmanship, domestic sourcing, and a deep customization menu underscores a pitch built on durability and personalization rather than volume discounting.

name: Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co
old_description: Experience the Ort difference: handcrafted, American-made furniture built with hardwood frames, Amish craftsmanship, and backed by a lifetime limited warranty for lasting comfort.
about:
Founded in 1957 in Salem, Ohio, Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co. has spent more than six decades building recliners and upholstered seating for the residential market. The company operates from its Ohio facility, where it combines traditional woodworking with modern recliner mechanisms.

The product line centers on recliners—over 70 styles including electric power, wall-hugger, swivel rocker, oversized “Goliath,” and Mission-inspired models—along with sofas, love seats, chairs, modular seating, gliders, and ottomans. Each piece starts with a solid hardwood frame assembled by Amish craftsmen, then upholstered in one of more than 360 fabric or leather options sourced from domestic mills. The company also produces the Timbercraft Mission collection and offers custom configuration on many models.

Ort Furniture sells exclusively through independent retail furniture stores across the Midwest, supplying dealers who serve homeowners seeking durable, American-made seating. The company does not sell direct to consumers; its business model is built on wholesale relationships with brick-and-mortar showrooms.

The brand emphasizes a lifetime limited warranty on frames and mechanisms, sustainably harvested hardwood, and strengthened steel hardware. Fast, free shipping on every order and a 15-day return policy for retail partners are cited as service differentiators.

about:
Located in West Springfield, Massachusetts, Osgood Textile Company has served fabric enthusiasts for over six decades. The business operates from a single location on Park Street, offering a brick-and-mortar store alongside an e-commerce presence through OnlineFabricStore.com. Ownership details and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The company maintains a large, rotating inventory of fabrics for apparel sewing, upholstery, quilting, and home décor projects. Beyond fabric sales, Osgood Textile provides custom window treatment services, including design, fabrication, and installation of blinds, shades, and draperies. They carry products from brands such as Hunter Douglas, Graber, Kirsch, Alta, and Lutron, and handle commercial projects for offices, colleges, churches, and other institutions.

Customers range from individual crafters and designers to commercial clients seeking window solutions for institutional spaces. The fabric selection supports apparel, upholstery, quilting, and home décor work, while the custom window treatment division serves offices, educational facilities, and religious organizations.

Osgood Textile emphasizes its vast and ever-changing fabric selection at competitive prices, and highlights its expert team’s ability to design and install functional, tailored window treatments for both residential and commercial spaces.

name: Otco Inc
old_description: Built to Protect Your Facility, Improve Energy, & Keep Every Load Secure
about:
OTCO, Inc. was founded in 1988 in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, as a fourth‑generation family‑owned industrial contract sewing manufacturer. The company began with a focus on custom textile fabrication and has remained under family ownership for nearly four decades.

Today OTCO operates a modern manufacturing facility in Wisconsin where it produces a range of heavy‑duty sewn products. Its capabilities include custom industrial sewing, protective lift‑table skirting and guards, high‑performance loading‑dock seals and shelters, accordion‑style bellow guards, and custom zipper and lockable bags for banking, medical, and government use. The shop handles projects from prototype through production runs, offering branding options such as sewn‑in tags, silk‑screen printing, and embroidery.

The company serves customers across manufacturing and industrial, warehousing and logistics, medical and healthcare, government and municipal, banking and financial services, education and institutions, and retail and commercial sectors. Clients include businesses, retailers, government agencies, hospitals, and schools that require durable, safety‑focused sewn solutions.

OTCO emphasizes that every item is American‑made in its Wisconsin plant, built to customer specifications with precision materials and consistent inspection at each production stage. The firm describes its approach as hands‑on problem‑solving that delivers reliable turnaround and consistent quality.

name: Otter Tail Power Company
old_description: Keeping power reliable and costs predictable for the communities we serve
about:
Otter Tail Power Company is headquartered in Devils Lake, North Dakota. For nearly 120 years, the utility has generated, transmitted, and delivered electricity across a service territory that spans Minnesota, South Dakota, and North Dakota. The company's origins trace back to the early 20th century, though a precise founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership structure is not disclosed in available materials.

The company operates as an integrated electric utility, managing generation, transmission, and distribution assets to serve residential, agricultural, commercial, and institutional customers. Its service portfolio includes electricity delivery, outage response, energy efficiency rebate programs, and customer self-service tools for account management. The utility serves homes, farms, schools, hospitals, and businesses across its three-state region.

Customers range from individual households and family farms to school districts, healthcare facilities, and commercial enterprises in Minnesota, South Dakota, and North Dakota. The utility also works with communities on local partnerships, volunteerism, and charitable giving initiatives.

Three priorities guide decision-making: affordability through responsible cost management and thoughtful investment; reliability via ongoing grid maintenance and strengthening; and community impact through local partnerships and charitable giving. The company emphasizes planning for future energy needs while protecting affordability and reliability for the customers it serves.

name: Our World Energy, LLC
old_description: Get your customized solar plan and quote by filling out this form.
about:
Our World Energy, LLC is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. The company was founded in 2016 by Caleb Antonucci, who initially created the business as a bridge connecting solar professionals with homeowners seeking affordable energy independence. Today, the firm operates as a direct installer of solar energy systems.

The company designs and installs solar panel systems using what it describes as locally manufactured solar panel technologies. Its installation teams consist of certified solar specialists who are also cross-trained as roofing experts, allowing them to integrate systems with the existing roof structure. Our World Energy serves customers across more than a dozen states, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, and Texas, though it does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual installation volumes.

The primary customer base is residential homeowners looking to reduce monthly energy costs and achieve energy independence. The company markets its solutions directly to families, emphasizing a seamless, transparent partnership from initial quote through installation and warranty coverage. Service locations span Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Puerto Rico, Rhode Island, Texas, Vermont, and Virginia.

Our World Energy differentiates itself with a 25-year, no-strings-attached warranty that covers both the panels and the installation work. The firm also highlights its people-first approach, promising a stress-free process that increases home value while maximizing efficiency. These commitments stem from the founder’s original vision of making true energy independence accessible to every homeowner.

name: Outcast Autoworks LLC.

about:
Outcast Autoworks LLC operates from Sarasota, Florida, where it designs and fabricates custom truck and automotive components. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The shop focuses on performance upgrades for the Ford Crown Victoria platform, producing adjustable upper control arms, billet engine mounts, suspension kits, and related hardware. In-house capabilities include design, welding, machining of thick-gauge steel ball-joint plates, and assembly of bolt-in ball joints that can be removed for finishing. Each kit ships with all necessary hardware, bushings, and alignment shims. The company lists its core competencies as design, welding, suspension, and performance parts manufacturing.

Customers are primarily automotive enthusiasts and repair shops seeking direct-replacement performance parts for Crown Victoria models. The product line also includes branded merchandise such as apparel and decals. No specific industry certifications or export registrations are mentioned.

The company’s stated goal is to turn aging vehicles into reliable daily drivers, summarized by the tagline “From CLUNKER to COMMUTER.”

name: Outdoor Interiors
old_description: Explore fresh horizons with us as we introduce you to some groundbreaking innovations. Your journey to a more stylish and comfortable year begins here!
about:
Outdoor Interiors was founded in 2006 in Lake Barrington, Illinois, by Tim Cimaglio, who remains president. The company began with the goal of creating a unique product line in the outdoor living space, targeting an underserved niche with quality at mid-tier price points.

The company designs and manufactures outdoor furniture using sustainable, plantation-grown FSC-certified teak and eucalyptus, along with powder-coated aluminum, HDPE all-weather wicker, nautical rope, sling, concrete composite, fabrics, and natural stone. Its collections include fully assembled folding loungers, stacking chairs, table sets, daybeds, and coordinating throw pillows. Operations span over 70,000 square feet of warehouse space and a 5,000-square-foot showroom at Atlanta’s AmericasMart, serving a network of more than 150 dealers and key retail groups across North America.

Outdoor Interiors sells primarily through its nationwide dealer network and retail partners, with showrooms in Lake Barrington available by appointment. Its customers include independent patio and garden retailers, specialty outdoor living stores, and larger retail groups seeking mid-priced, design-forward furniture.

The brand differentiates itself by focusing on sustainable sourcing, innovative storage solutions integrated into its furniture, and a blend of mixed materials that deliver both style and durability at accessible price points.
